meta.title: Hedayat Educational Foundation
meta.description: Hedayat Educational Foundation is a licensed educational foundation that promotes reliable knowledge and deeper community awareness through purposeful programs, qualified expertise, and accessible contemporary methods.

hero.headline: A Beacon of Guidance for Deeper Community Awareness
hero.lead: A trusted educational foundation specializing in reliable knowledge that supports the nation’s higher values through purposeful programs, qualified expertise, and accessible, engaging methods.

about.title: Who We Are
about.subtitle: A licensed educational foundation focused on reliable knowledge, well-grounded awareness, and contemporary learning methods.
about.cardText: We provide reliable knowledge through accessible and engaging educational methods.
about.p1: We work to build awareness that protects individuals and society from intellectual and values-based deviations through reliable content and purposeful educational programs.
about.p2: We balance sound knowledge with contemporary learning methods to strengthen identity and values and create sustainable impact.

items.text: Empowering girls to distinguish reliable knowledge from misleading claims and build strong intellectual and values-based resilience.
Preparing educational practitioners who can deepen understanding and conviction rather than merely transfer information.
Helping teachers connect curricula with contemporary developments and current intellectual questions.
Achieving financial sustainability to maintain programs and expand community impact.
